text.text_excerpt: We got lunch from this truck today. They have a very large menu that is somewhat diverse. I'm not sure how they are able to have such a big menu for a little truck! Their main feature is Mediterranean food (Gyros, Shawarma, Falafel, Hummus, Baklava and whole platters) But, they also have salads, poboys, and seafood platters. Be prepared for a long wait. We waited about 20 minutes. There are only 2 people on the truck - 1 cashier and 1 cook. So, it takes some time. Their truck sign says you can call in and order ahead. That's probably a good idea. I got the Gyro platter and my coworker got a Hot Sausage Poboy. My platter was enough food for 2 meals! Another coworker got the Chicken Shawarm...

One of my favorite food trucks, service and food are great and it's a nice break from the traditional meals I bring from home/ pick up near the office. They specialize in Mediterranean food and are pretty quick at serving it up. My personal picks are normally the Gyro sandwich and an order of their seasoned fries. They've recently undergone a rebranding and are now servicing the area as the Sultan Food Truck and with that change added Kebabs to the menu. I had a beef kebab today and thoroughly enjoyed it. I'll probably try the chicken one the next time I see them.

Sultan's Food Truck parked outside my workplace today. We always appreciate the food trucks coming by because there's not a lot of options in the area for lunch. The menu had a good selection of lunch options. I ordered the Gyro Bowl. It was served within 5 minutes. This is important when you only have 30 minutes for lunch. The gyro meat was on a bed of lettuce. It was topped with red onions, red peppers, olives, and feta cheese. There was a side of hummus and bread. It was delicious. I hope they come by again next week.
